headline: Kharg shock keeps closed-market Nasdaq regime at WATCH
body: The reported strike on an Iranian tanker near Kharg Island remains the main discontinuity risk. Record U.S. Labor Day gasoline prices and Friday's higher-yield repricing reinforce macro Stress. NQ is closed, so the assessment contains no live evidence of persistent mean-reversion failure.
